tools.name: check_policy
tools.description:
Read one privacy policy or terms-of-service page and return a grounded verdict, eight fixed answers (yes, no, partly or not_stated), and up to five findings, each with a verbatim quote from the document.

Use this instead of fetching and reading the page yourself. A policy page is 20,000-60,000 toke

tools.name: compare_policies
tools.description:
Answer the same eight fixed questions across two to five services at once, so their policies can actually be compared.

Use this instead of reading each document yourself. Doing it yourself needs N full reads and a rubric you have to keep consistent between them; the questions here are fixed, so a d

tools.name: policy_changes_since
tools.description:
Say what changed in a service's policy since a date, expressed as changes to the eight fixed answers.

You cannot do this yourself at any context size: it needs the earlier version of the document, and the earlier version is gone from the web. Policy Pal keeps the eight answers for every version it

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_policy" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
